rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the gymnastic or recreational jumping device.

example.english: The kids need supervision when jumping on the trampoline at home.
example.traditional: 小朋友喺屋企跳彈床，要有人睇住先得。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 uk1 kei2 tiu3 daan6 cong4 jiu3 jau5 jan4 tai2 zyu6 sin1 dak1

rows.note: Use this specifically for trampoline as a competitive sport rather than the equipment itself.

example.english: We entered a trampoline competition and practise somersault routines every day.
example.traditional: 我哋參加彈床運動比賽，日日都操練翻騰動作。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 caam1 gaa1 daan6 cong4 wan6 dung6 bei2 coi3 jat6 jat6 dou1 cou1 lin6 faan1 tang4 dung6 zok3
